title: Lewis P. and Linda L. Geyser University Professor, Emeritus
affiliation: Lewis P. and Linda L. Geyser University Professor, Emeritus
bio: William Julius Wilson is Lewis P. and Linda L. Geyser University Professor, Emeritus, at Harvard University. He is one of only 25 University Professors, the highest professional distinction for a Harvard faculty member. After receiving the Ph.D. from Washington State University in 1966, Wilson taught sociology at the University of Massachusetts at Amherst, before joining the University of Chicago faculty in 1972. In 1990 he was appointed the Lucy Flower University Professor and director of the University of Chicago's Center for the Study of Urban Inequality.
